name: Crossroads Specter: On Champion Hit the opponent banishes a card of their choice from their material deck
notes: Crossroads Specter hits player 2's champion; the banish choice belongs to the opponent and is written in player 2's own frame (myMaterial-N). Player 2 picks the second material card, which leaves the material deck for their banishment (the first stays).

rulesClauses: On Champion Hit: That opponent banishes a card from their material deck.
